title: Absolute Continuity of Monotone Aggregations under Positive Regression Dependence
summary: In this paper, we provide a sufficient condition for the absolute continuity of one-dimensional push-forwards of dependent random vectors. Suppose that $X$ has an absolutely continuous distribution and that the conditional distribution of an $\mathbb{R}^d$-valued random vector $Y$ given $X=x$ is nondecreasing in $x\in \mathbb{R}$ in the usual stochastic order.
